name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
coverage_details: Cashless cover up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled public and private hospitals for ~1,900 listed procedures. No cap on family size or age.
application_steps: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in ('Am I Eligible') or call 14555 with your ration card / mobile number
Visit the nearest empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra / PMAM desk with a government photo ID
Get the Ayushman card verified or generated on the spot before admission where possible
note: SAMPLE DATA - income threshold is a simplification for this demo. Real PM-JAY eligibility uses SECC 2011 deprivation / occupational criteria (rural) and occupational categories (urban), not a flat income cutoff. Some states also run PM-JAY in convergence with a state scheme. Verify on the official portal.

name: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
coverage_details: Covers serving and retired central government employees, MPs, pensioners, and their dependents at CGHS wellness centres and empanelled hospitals/diagnostic labs, on a contributory basis.
application_steps: Confirm central government employee / pensioner status and CGHS-covered city
Apply for a CGHS card through your office (serving) or pension disbursing authority (pensioner) with the prescribed contribution
Use the card at any CGHS wellness centre; for hospitalisation get a referral from the wellness centre medical officer
note: SAMPLE DATA - eligibility simplified. State government employees are covered by separate state schemes, not CGHS. Verify current rules and covered cities on the official CGHS portal.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Arogya Karnataka
coverage_details: State scheme converged with PM-JAY. Eligible (BPL) households get cashless secondary and tertiary care; general (APL) households get partial (co-payment) cover with government referral.
application_steps: Confirm Karnataka residency and check BPL / APL status on your ration card
Register at a government hospital or an Arogya Mitra desk with Aadhaar and ration card
Get the health card issued or verified; tertiary care needs a referral from a government hospital
note: SAMPLE DATA - simplified for demo. APL cover is partial and referral-based. Verify on the official Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust portal.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
coverage_details: Cashless cover (converged with PM-JAY, cover raised to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year) for listed surgeries and therapies at empanelled hospitals for yellow / orange / Antyodaya / white-affected-area ration card holders.
application_steps: Confirm Maharashtra residency and eligible ration-card colour (yellow / orange / Antyodaya)
Approach an Arogya Mitra at an empanelled hospital with ration card and a government photo ID
Arogya Mitra registers the case and applies for pre-authorisation before treatment
note: SAMPLE DATA - income proxy stands in for ration-card category. Verify categories and the empanelled hospital list on the official MJPJAY / State Health Assurance Society portal.

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
coverage_details: Cashless cover up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year over a block period for listed procedures at government and empanelled private hospitals; certain high-cost procedures covered beyond the cap.
application_steps: Confirm Tamil Nadu residency and family annual income at or below Rs. 1,20,000
Enrol at a common service centre / e-Sevai centre or government hospital with income certificate, ration card and Aadhaar
Use the issued smart card at any empanelled hospital; the hospital's insurance desk handles pre-authorisation
note: SAMPLE DATA - simplified. Verify the income limit, document list and empanelled hospitals on the official CMCHIS portal.

name: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana
coverage_details: Universal state health scheme for Rajasthan residents. Free for NFSA / SECC / small-and-marginal-farmer / contractual-worker families; other families join by paying an annual premium. Cover up to Rs. 25 lakh per family per year plus accident cover.
application_steps: Confirm Rajasthan residency and check whether your family is in a free category (NFSA / SECC / farmer / contractual worker)
Register on the SSO Rajasthan portal or at an e-Mitra kiosk with Jan Aadhaar; pay the premium if not in a free category
Use the Jan Aadhaar / policy at any empanelled government or private hospital
note: SAMPLE DATA - no income rule modelled because the scheme is universal with a premium for non-free categories. Verify free-category list and current premium on the official portal.

name: Dr. YSR / Rajiv Aarogyasri Health Care Trust (Telangana)
coverage_details: Cashless cover for listed secondary and tertiary procedures for white (food-security) ration card holding families of Telangana at network hospitals, with follow-up medication support for some procedures.
application_steps: Confirm Telangana residency and a white / food-security ration card
Visit an Aarogyasri Health Coordinator (Aarogya Mithra) at a network hospital with ration card and Aadhaar
The coordinator registers the case and obtains e-preauthorisation from the Trust
note: SAMPLE DATA - income proxy stands in for the white ration-card criterion. Verify on the official Aarogyasri Health Care Trust portal.

name: Swasthya Sathi (West Bengal)
coverage_details: Universal cashless cover up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care at empanelled hospitals in and outside West Bengal. Fully state-funded; the card is issued in the name of the eldest woman of the household.
application_steps: Confirm West Bengal residency (all families not covered by another government health scheme are eligible)
Apply through a Duare Sarkar camp or the Swasthya Sathi portal with Aadhaar and address proof
Use the Swasthya Sathi smart card at any empanelled hospital's help desk
note: SAMPLE DATA - no income rule modelled because the scheme is universal for residents not covered elsewhere. Verify on the official Swasthya Sathi portal.

name: Delhi Arogya Kosh (DAK)
coverage_details: Financial assistance for Delhi residents for surgeries, diagnostics, implants and cancer / trauma care at Delhi Government and empanelled private hospitals, where the treatment is not otherwise free at a government facility.
application_steps: Confirm at least three years' Delhi residency and family income within the notified limit
Get a referral and estimate from the treating Delhi Government hospital
Apply to the Arogya Kosh cell with the estimate, income certificate, residence proof and Aadhaar
note: SAMPLE DATA - income limit and residency period are approximate. Verify current terms with the Delhi Government Health & Family Welfare Department.
